title: Operation Detail Optional Lookup Permission Consistency

items.action: resolve optional linked todo detail enrichment
resolve optional scraper adapter detail enrichment

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing backend endpoint authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; optional frontend detail clients now fail closed before unauthorized requests.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation item changes are required.

route_guard.reason: Operation Detail remains accessible with operations.read because linked Todo and Adapter data are optional enrichment only.

forms.reason: No form behavior changes are introduced.

notes: Operation Detail is intentionally scoped to fair_crm.operations.read. Linked Todo and scraper Adapter labels are optional enrichment. Previously those lookups could still call protected endpoints and swallow backend 403 responses when the user lacked fair_crm.todos.read or fair_crm.scraper.read. The shared detail clients now fail closed locally, preserving the page fallback behavior while preventing unauthorized HTTP requests.
